description: Suite-level routing set for the customer beancount-* skills. Each entry names the one skill that should handle the prompt, or `none` when no suite skill should. `confusable` lists skills the prompt could be mistaken for: an entry is a near-miss negative for every confusable skill other than its expected one. Validated by scripts/ci-check.py; run against real clients with scripts/run-routing.py (never in CI).

entries.prompt: How much did I spend on groceries last month?
entries.why: A spending question answered from the local ledger.

entries.prompt: What's my net worth right now according to my ledger?
entries.why: Balance-sheet question; read-only.

entries.prompt: Which of my subscriptions went up in price this year?
entries.why: Recurring-merchant trend question.

entries.prompt: What were my top five expense categories in 2026?
entries.why: A ranking query, not a period close or report commit.

entries.prompt: How many transactions did I import from Chase last month?
entries.why: Counts entries already in the ledger; nothing is imported.

entries.prompt: Let's do the month-end close for September.
entries.why: The month-end ritual by name.

entries.prompt: Wrap up the books for last month and commit the result.
entries.why: Closing a period and committing it.

entries.prompt: Reconcile all of my accounts for June, check the flags, and close the period.
entries.why: Multi-account reconciliation plus close is the close skill's orchestration, not one-account reconcile.

entries.prompt: Import this Chase CSV into my ledger: ./downloads/chase-activity.csv
entries.why: A bank CSV export into an existing ledger.

entries.prompt: I downloaded a QFX file from my credit union. Can you record it in my books? It's ./export.qfx

entries.prompt: Record the transactions from my Amex export ./amex.csv
entries.why: Card export import.

entries.prompt: Import ./chase-oct.csv the same way as last time; the source is already set up in my ledger's import config.
entries.why: A repeat import uses the stored config; no importer needs writing.

entries.prompt: Import my June statement PDF into my ledger — my bank has no CSV export.
entries.why: Recording a PDF statement's rows is an import; reconcile compares against a statement the ledger should already match.

entries.prompt: Record the transactions in ./may-statement.pdf in my ledger.
entries.why: A whole statement file to record, not one manual entry and not a comparison.

entries.prompt: My credit union only gives PDF statements. Import this one and attach the file to the account.
entries.why: PDF-only source importing with the document attached; reconcile would diff against existing entries instead.

entries.why: A reusable, tested importer from a sample file.

entries.prompt: My importer for Ally broke because they renamed the CSV headers. Can you fix it?
entries.why: Repairing an existing importer after format drift.

entries.prompt: I've imported this bank's CSV by hand four times now. Turn it into a real tested importer I can run myself.
entries.why: Graduating a repeated import into code.

entries.prompt: Set up a new beancount ledger in this folder.
entries.why: Scaffolding a fresh ledger.

entries.prompt: I want to start plain-text accounting. Create a fresh ledger here in USD with no history.
entries.why: A new ledger with nothing to migrate.

entries.prompt: Bootstrap a beancount repo with Fava so I can browse it in my browser.
entries.why: init's optional Fava setup.

entries.prompt: Mint shut down and I have a CSV export of all my transactions. Move my history into beancount.
entries.why: Finance-app history into a fresh ledger.

entries.prompt: Convert my Monarch Money export into a beancount ledger.
entries.why: Finance-app export conversion.

entries.prompt: Migrate my QuickBooks Online transactions into a new ledger.
entries.why: QBO history migration.

entries.prompt: Import my full Mint history into a new ledger.
entries.why: Says import, but full finance-app history into a new ledger is a migration.

entries.prompt: Create a new ledger and bring in my Monarch export.
entries.why: Migration composes init; the history is the point.

entries.prompt: I sold a cash-secured put on AAPL, 150 strike expiring June 20, for 1.50. Record it.
entries.why: An options trade to record.

entries.prompt: My covered call on MSFT got assigned yesterday. Book it in my ledger.

entries.prompt: Record this fill: Sold to Open 1 SPY Dec 19 '26 600/590 put spread @ 2.10

entries.prompt: Does my checking account match the bank statement for May? ./may-statement.csv

entries.prompt: Reconcile my Amex against this statement PDF: ./amex-june.pdf
entries.why: Statement reconciliation from a PDF.

entries.prompt: My savings balance in the ledger doesn't match what the bank shows. Compare it with ./statement.csv.
entries.why: A balance discrepancy against a statement.

entries.prompt: Here is my June checking statement. Add whatever transactions are missing and assert the ending balance. ./june.csv
entries.why: Missing entries plus a balance assertion is reconcile, not a bulk import.

entries.prompt: Reconcile my checking account for June.
entries.why: One account, not the whole close.

entries.prompt: Close my old Amex card account in the ledger. I cancelled the card.
entries.why: Closing one account is a `close` directive, not a period close.

entries.prompt: Mark Assets:Bank:OldSavings as closed as of today.
entries.why: A `close` directive, not a period close.

entries.prompt: Set the operating_currency option in my ledger to EUR.
entries.why: A Beancount `option` setting, not an options trade.

entries.prompt: Which beancount options should I set at the top of my main file?
entries.why: Ledger `option` directives (documentation), not options trading.

entries.prompt: How do I use a beancount option to rename the Assets and Liabilities roots?
entries.why: The `name_*` options; documentation.

entries.prompt: Explain how a covered call works and whether I should sell one.
entries.why: Options education and advice; the options skill records trades only.

entries.prompt: What are the greeks on my AAPL 150 put?
entries.why: Pricing and greeks are out of every skill's scope.

entries.prompt: What does `bea ask` do, and how is it different from `bea query`?
entries.why: A question about the CLI, not about the ledger.

entries.prompt: How do I write a BQL query that groups by month?
entries.why: General BQL documentation.

entries.prompt: What is the difference between a balance and a pad directive in beancount?
entries.why: General Beancount documentation.

entries.prompt: I paid $42 for dinner on the Amex tonight. Add it to my ledger.
entries.why: One manual purchase.

entries.prompt: Add a transaction: $1,200 rent paid from checking on the 1st.
entries.why: One manual bill payment.

entries.prompt: Open a new account Assets:Bank:HighYieldSavings in my ledger.
entries.why: An `open` directive in an existing ledger, not a new ledger.

entries.prompt: Fix the typo in the payee of yesterday's Starbucks transaction.
entries.why: Editing an existing entry; every skill appends only.

entries.prompt: My ledger is hosted on Beancount.io and I'm connected through its MCP server. What did I spend on dining last month?
entries.why: A hosted ledger; the local skills do not apply.

entries.prompt: Using the Beancount.io MCP connection, close the month for my hosted ledger.
entries.why: A hosted ledger; the MCP server has its own close-month prompt.

entries.prompt: My books live on Beancount.io (MCP connected). Reconcile my checking account against ./june.csv.
entries.why: A hosted ledger.

entries.prompt: Record a $250 transfer from checking to savings today.
entries.why: A transfer between the user's own accounts, entered by hand.

entries.prompt: Here's my receipt: Costco 2026-10-12, groceries 84.10, household 31.55, paid with the Amex. Book it.
entries.why: A split purchase from pasted receipt text, not an export file.

entries.prompt: Add a price to my ledger: 1 VTI = 285.40 USD as of today.
entries.why: A price directive.

entries.prompt: I got paid $3,200 salary into checking on Friday. Record it.
entries.why: One income entry.

entries.prompt: Add a $42 dinner to my ledger on Beancount.io through the MCP connection.
entries.why: A hosted ledger.

entries.prompt: Record that I bought 10 shares of VTI at $250 in my Roth
entries.why: A described securities purchase with a lot to book.

entries.prompt: I sold some bitcoin, record the gain
entries.why: A crypto sale whose gain comes from lot booking.

entries.prompt: Record my RSU vest
entries.why: An equity-compensation vest recorded at fair-market value.

entries.prompt: What has VTI returned for me this year?
entries.why: A performance question about holdings, not an event to record.

entries.prompt: I paid $42 for dinner
entries.why: An everyday purchase, not an investment event.

entries.prompt: Import my brokerage CSV into my ledger: ./fidelity-2026.csv
entries.why: A statement file to import, not a described trade.

entries.prompt: VTI paid me a $45 cash dividend in my brokerage account — record it
entries.why: A dividend on a holding is an investment event, not an everyday entry.

entries.prompt: ACME did a 4-for-1 stock split today; update my holding
entries.why: A split rewrites lot units at unchanged total cost — a trade procedure.

entries.prompt: Move 4 of my VTI shares from my brokerage account to my Roth IRA account, keeping their cost basis
entries.why: Moving lots between own accounts must keep cost and acquisition date.

entries.prompt: What do I hold and what is it worth at market?
entries.why: A read-only holdings/valuation question, not a trade to record.

entries.prompt: Should I sell my VTI before year end for the tax benefit?
entries.why: Investment/tax advice; no skill gives it and nothing is to be recorded.

entries.prompt: Record my last four paycheck 401(k) buys: 2 VTI each month since January at 250, 260, 255, and 270
entries.why: Described trades in a batch, not a file import or everyday entries.

entries.prompt: Import this Coinbase transaction history CSV into my ledger: ./coinbase-2026.csv
entries.why: An activity file to import as lots, not a described trade.

entries.prompt: Here is my broker's cost-basis export — set up my existing holdings in my new ledger
entries.why: Seeding opening lots from a holdings export, not a finance-app migration or a new trade.

entries.prompt: I bought a house for $500,000 with 20% down and a $400,000 mortgage — record it
entries.why: A property purchase books the home as a lot plus its mortgage and escrow, not an everyday entry.

entries.prompt: I paid $1,800 rent for my apartment
entries.why: Paying rent as a tenant is an everyday expense, not property ownership.

entries.prompt: Record this month's mortgage payment: $2,400 — $600 principal, $1,500 interest, $300 escrow
entries.why: A mortgage split tied to the loan statement balance, not an everyday split entry.

entries.prompt: I sold my rental house for $650,000; the mortgage payoff was $399,400 — record the sale
entries.why: A property sale closes its lot and mortgage with a payoff tie-out.

entries.prompt: My tenant paid $1,800 rent for the Oak Street rental
entries.why: Rental income per property (deposit handling included), not a generic income entry.

entries.prompt: I swapped 0.2 BTC for 4 ETH — record the swap (it was worth $12,000)
entries.why: A crypto-to-crypto swap is a priced disposal plus acquisition in one entry.

entries.prompt: Record my ETH staking rewards: 0.01 ETH on Feb 1 worth $29, 0.011 on Mar 1 worth $33
entries.why: Receipts become dated lots against income, like a vest — not generic income entries.

entries.prompt: What's the current price of Bitcoin right now?
entries.why: A live market quote, not a ledger question or a trade to record.

entries.prompt: Why is my prepaid insurance balance what it is at the end of January?
entries.why: Opening-to-closing explanation of one balance-sheet account.

entries.prompt: Roll my loan balance forward for last quarter and show every movement.
entries.why: Period roll-forward of a liability account.

entries.prompt: What was that one charge on my card on March 3?
entries.why: A single-entry question, not a balance explanation.

entries.prompt: Prepare the accruals for June and draft the rent accrual from our lease schedule.
entries.why: Schedule-based period accrual drafts, not a full close or a one-off entry.

entries.prompt: My rent payment is missing this month, record the expense for me.
entries.why: A single described entry; an accrual is never inferred from absence alone.

entries.prompt: Compare my actual June expenses with May in the local ledger, and show which categories explain the difference.
entries.why: A read-only expense variance question across periods, not one balance-sheet roll-forward or a close.

entries.prompt: I have my monthly budget here and a local Beancount ledger. Compare June actual spending with the budget and explain the category variances.
entries.why: A read-only budget-to-actual analytical request, not preparation of accrual drafts.

entries.prompt: I paid my landlord $1,200 rent from checking today. Record this payment in my local ledger.
entries.why: An ordinary one-off described rent payment, without property management or schedule-based accrual preparation.

entries.prompt: What was the balance of my savings account on June 30 in this local ledger? I only need that date’s balance.
entries.why: A point-in-time historical balance lookup, without an explanation of movement or statement comparison.

entries.prompt: Show my checking account balances on May 31 and June 30 from my local ledger; no movement schedule needed.
entries.why: Two point-in-time balances rather than an opening-to-closing movement explanation.

entries.prompt: Extract the transaction table from ./may-statement.pdf into a CSV. Do not import it into a ledger.
entries.why: PDF extraction only; no ledger import or reconciliation requested.

entries.prompt: Merge these two scanned PDFs into one searchable PDF.
entries.why: Generic PDF manipulation/OCR belongs to a PDF helper, with no ledger workflow.

entries.prompt: What was my profit by client last month?
entries.why: A read-only report by the client metadata key.

entries.prompt: Which of my projects lost money this quarter according to my books?
entries.why: Per-project income and expense totals; read-only.

entries.prompt: Invoice Acme Corp for 3,000 USD of consulting, invoice INV-031 dated today, due in 30 days. Record it in my ledger.
entries.why: Issuing a client invoice creates a receivable tracked by document.

entries.prompt: Acme paid 1,200 of invoice INV-031 today into checking. Record the payment in my books.
entries.why: A payment applied to an open invoice reduces that document's receivable.

entries.prompt: I paid my contractor Dana 500 USD from checking yesterday for design work. Add it to my ledger.
entries.why: A one-off payment with no document to track is an everyday entry.

entries.prompt: Record this supplier bill: Bolt Printing invoice 7781, 450 USD for brochures, due November 15.
entries.why: A supplier bill creates a payable tracked by document.

entries.prompt: Which clients still owe me money, and how overdue are they?
entries.why: Open-invoice aging is the invoices skill's read.

entries.prompt: I filed my Q3 sales tax return and paid the 1,240 USD due from checking. Record the remittance.
entries.why: A remittance clears collected sales tax.

entries.prompt: Accrue this month's share of the 12,000 USD annual software contract we prepaid in January.
entries.why: A period-end schedule, not a document lifecycle.
